# Public synthetic landmark-input fixtures

Tiny one-ordinary/one-residual-update fixtures for the explicit v3 input and
feature-masked control graphs. The fixed 23 gains and masks are artificial test
inputs, not claimed cross-validation measurements or model-quality evidence.

`learned_landmark_inputs` checks Python/native operators at unchanged 0.002 code
tolerance, exact prefixes and target-free isolation. The separate real CLI
journey executes native five-fold landmarks on a small owned table, binds its
private report and CSV, encodes, removes the report/CSV/encoder and samples from
all four recipient tiers. Private checkpoints/raw data are not fixture members.
